_comment: Canonical pin for the AMICI reference build used by the amici_parity ODE sweep. Previously AMICI was an unpinned local editable build (a checkout under a developer home dir), recorded nowhere committed — so every AMICI PASS/DIFF/REFERENCE_FAILED/timing claim in AMICI_KNOWN_ISSUES.md was tied to an unreconstructable environment. This file pins the exact upstream commit our results were generated against. `describe` is authoritative; the bare `amici.__version__` (stamped into reports via _core.versions.amici_version) reports only the release string ('1.2.0' for this commit) and omits the commit-level detail below. Every AMICI-build reference (README, AMICI_KNOWN_ISSUES.md) points here.
commit_subject: CI: Revisit SBML test suite sensitivity check skips (#3547)

build.install: uv sync --extra dev --group amici (PEP 735 group in pyproject.toml; a group and not an extra because the pin is a direct reference, which PyPI rejects in published metadata). Was previously a hand-installed editable build into bngsim/.venv, which `uv sync` pruned at the next run — the amici_parity suite then went silently unrunnable.
build.requires: swig + a C++ toolchain and BLAS (AMICI codegens and compiles a C++ model per SBML). macOS uses Accelerate, nothing to install; Linux pulls scipy-openblas64 via the build backend. The clone runs git's LFS filter, so a machine with filter.lfs.* configured must actually have the git-lfs binary present. AMICI 1.1.0 and later require Python >= 3.12.
build.reproduce: git clone https://github.com/AMICI-dev/AMICI && git -C AMICI checkout 7fb8c571ac9e4d5aafb85d5da08982ea7c5a19dc && pip install -e AMICI/python/sdist (per AMICI's install docs). The commit is an ancestor of AMICI-dev/AMICI main (22 commits past the v1.2.0 release tag), so it is fetchable by SHA.
build.runtime_stamp: amici_run reports also stamp the live package version via _core.versions.amici_version() (= '1.0.1'); this pin supplies the commit that the bare version string does not.
build.pin_guard: parity_checks/tests/test_amici_pin_agreement.py fails if this commit and pyproject.toml's [dependency-groups] amici drift. Do not relax the pin to amici==1.2.0 off PyPI: the release has the event regression above, which this commit fixes.

why_main_not_release: Pinned to AMICI main, not the v1.2.0 release: 1.2.0 fires a time trigger whose threshold an event moves only once (AMICI #3397 changed how those triggers are timed; main fixes it, #3490). BIOMD0000000241's dosing event, time >= t_int*cups + t_lag with cups := cups + 1, read as a 3902-cell DIFF on 1.2.0 and PASSes on this commit, as it did on 1.0.1.
